# pltr folder

Folder operations using foundry-platform-sdk.

Folders are addressed by RID (ri.compass.main.folder.<id>). Folders live inside projects, and projects inside spaces: find a space with 'pltr space list' and a project with 'pltr project list'. The API can't get or list the root folder (ri.compass.main.folder.0).

Examples:

        # Create a folder inside a project
        pltr folder create "My Folder" --parent-folder ri.compass.main.folder.xyz123
        # List a folder's contents (one page; --all for every page)
        pltr folder list ri.compass.main.folder.xyz123
        # Get folder information as JSON
        pltr folder get ri.compass.main.folder.xyz123 --format json

4 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

### pltr folder batch-get

Get several folders in one request.

`pltr folder batch-get FOLDER_RIDS... [OPTIONS]`

- `FOLDER_RIDS...`: Folder RIDs, separated by spaces (at most 1000).
- SDK: `filesystem.Folder.get_batch`

### pltr folder create

Create a folder inside a project or another folder.

`pltr folder create NAME --parent-folder TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `NAME`: Display name of the new folder.
- `--parent-folder`, `-p` TEXT (required): RID of the project or folder to create the folder in.
- SDK: `filesystem.Folder.create`

### pltr folder get

Get a folder's metadata.

`pltr folder get FOLDER_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `FOLDER_RID`: Folder RID (ri.compass.main.folder.<id>).
- SDK: `filesystem.Folder.get`

### pltr folder list

List the resources directly inside a folder.

`pltr folder list FOLDER_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `FOLDER_RID`: RID of the folder, project or space to list (the API can't list the root folder: find spaces with 'pltr space list').
- paged · SDK: `filesystem.Folder.children`
